units.source_text: 内大臣升任了太政大臣。

en.t: The Minister of the Left was promoted to Grand Minister of State.

units.source_text: 夕雾中将升任了中纳言，入朝谢恩。

en.t: Yugiri, the Middle Captain, was promoted to Middle Counselor and went to court to give thanks for the favor.
His graceful bearing shone even more brightly,

units.source_text: 自容貌以至一切言行举止，竟无半点瑕疵可指。

en.t: and from his appearance to every word and gesture, there was not the slightest flaw to point out.

units.source_text: 他的岳父新太政大臣看见了，甚为满意，

en.t: His father in law, the new Grand Minister of State, saw this and was deeply satisfied,

units.source_text: 心念云居雁与其入宫受人排挤，

en.t: thinking that if Kumoi no Kari were to enter the palace only to be pushed aside by others,

units.source_text: 远不如嫁与夕雾之为幸福。

en.t: she would be far happier married to Yugiri.

units.source_text: 夕雾有一次回想起从前有一晚云居雁的乳母大辅嫌他官位低微，

en.t: One day Yugiri recalled an earlier evening when Kumoi no Kari's nurse, Taifu, had looked down on his low rank,

units.source_text: 曾说“嫁个六位小京官，也太不体面了”的话，

en.t: and had said, "It would be terribly disgraceful to marry a petty sixth rank court official,"

units.source_text: 便把一枝已经变成鲜美的紫色的白菊花送给大辅，

en.t: so he sent Taifu a branch of white chrysanthemum that had already turned a vivid purple,
and attached this poem to it:
